post.title: The candy company behind your rising vet bills
post.ig:
The company behind Snickers runs about 3,000 vet hospitals.
Mars owns Banfield, VCA and BluePearl; its vet network is about 3,000 clinics worldwide (Mars Veterinary Health).
US vet prices rose 8.8% in 2022 and 9.4% in 2023 (BLS CPI, annual averages).
Big groups own about 25% of US general vet clinics and about 75% of specialty and ER hospitals (2024 estimates).
The UK competition watchdog found vet prices rose 63% from 2016 to 2023, vs 31.3% inflation (CMA).
Our math: a $200 vet bill at 2015 prices is about $313 by 2024; prices overall, about $265.
Sources: BLS, Mars Veterinary Health, Stateline, UK CMA.
